tasks.label: Build 8051
tasks.command: $f='${fileBasename}'; if($f -like '*.a51'){ $a=Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' 'asem5113\asemw.exe'; if(-not (Test-Path $a)){Write-Error ('ASEM-51 not found: '+$a); exit 1}; & $a $f; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $sdcc=(Get-Command sdcc.exe -EA SilentlyContinue).Source; if(-not $sdcc -and $env:SDCC_HOME){$sdcc=Join-Path $env:SDCC_HOME 'bin\sdcc.exe'}; if(-not $sdcc -or -not (Test-Path $sdcc)){$sdcc='C:\Program Files\SDCC\bin\sdcc.exe'}; if(-not (Test-Path $sdcc)){Write-Error 'SDCC not found: add its bin folder to PATH or set SDCC_HOME'; exit 1}; $bin=Split-Path $sdcc; $env:PATH=$bin+';'+$env:PATH; & $sdcc -mmcs51 --model-small $f; if($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0){ & (Join-Path $bin 'packihx.exe') '${fileBasenameNoExtension}.ihx' | Set-Content -Encoding ascii '${fileBasenameNoExtension}.hex' }; exit $LASTEXITCODE
